arStrings.szText: "You went on quite a journey in your youth, didn't you?"
Indeed. Little did I know how terribly true the tales of Jered Cain would prove to be. I count myself fortunate that back then, I found only what I needed from them.
Though I must admit, I had a rough go of things once I returned to Tristram. I did my best to teach my people—to prepare them for the dangers of the world...as I did my best to drink my demons away.
Until that fateful day when I learned that demons were real...
